description.Name: Behaviorally-relevant features of observed actions dominate cortical representational geometry in natural vision

latestSnapshot.readme:
This dataset accompanies a manuscript titled "Behaviorally-relevant features of observed actions dominate cortical representational geometry in natural vision" by Jane Han, Vassiki Chauhan, Rebecca Philip, Morgan Taylor, Heejung Jung, Yaroslav O. Halchenko, M. Ida Gobbini, James V. Haxby, and Samuel A. Nastase:

Han, J., Chauhan, V., Philip, R., Taylor, M. K., Jung, H., Halchenko, Y. O., Gobbini, M. I., Haxby, J. V.\*, & Nastase, S. A.\* (2024). Behaviorally-relevant features of observed actions dominate cortical representational geometry in natural vision. *bioRxiv*. https://doi.org/10.1101/2024.11.26.624178

We collected 3T fMRI data using a condition-rich design in which *N* = 23 participants viewed 90 naturalistic video clips depicting humans performing a variety of social and nonsocial behaviors broadly sampling action space. Participants also watched the second half the movie *Raiders of the Lost Ark*.
